title: Selenium Organic Content Prediction in Jengkol (Archidendron pauciflorum) and Its Molecular Interaction with Cardioprotection Receptors PPAR-gamma, NF-kappaB, and PI3K.
authors: Shalihat, Ayu; Lesmana, Ronny; Hasanah, Aliya Nur; Mutakin, Mutakin
one_liner_zh: 该文预测Jengkol中有机硒成分并对其与PPAR-gamma、NF-kappaB、PI3K受体进行分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Selenium (Se) is a trace mineral found in plants with a distinct sulfuric odor that is cardioprotective and reported to have low toxicity. West Java, Indonesia, has a variety of plants with a distinct odor that are consumed raw, such as jengkol (Archidendron pauciflorum). This study is conducted to determine the Se content of jengkol using the fluorometric method, where the jengkol extract is separated, and the Se content is detected using high-pressure liquid chromatography (HPLC), combined with fluorometry. Two fractions with the highest Se concentration (A and B) are found and characterized using liquid chromatography mass spectrometry to predict the organic Se content by comparing the results with those in the external literature. The Se content of fraction (A) is found to be selenomethionine (m/z 198), gamma glutamyl-methyl-selenocysteine-(GluMetSeCys; m/z 313), and the Se-sulfur (S) conjugate of cysteine-selenoglutathione (m/z 475). Furthermore, these compounds are docked on receptors involved in cardioprotection. The receptors are peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-gamma (PPAR-gamma), nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB), and phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K/AKT). The interaction of receptor and ligan that has the lowest binding energy of the docking simulation is measured with molecular dynamic simulation. MD is performed to observe bond stability and conformation based on root mean square deviation, root mean square fluctuation, radius gyration, and MM-PBSA parameters. The results of the MD simulation show that the stability of the complex organic Se compounds tested with the receptors is lower than that of the native ligand, while the binding energy is lower than that of the native ligand based on the MM-PSBA parameter. This indicates that the predicted organic Se in jengkol, i.e., gamma-GluMetSeCys to PPAR-gamma, gamma-GluMetSeCys AKT/PI3K, and Se-S conjugate of cysteine-selenoglutathione to NF-kappaB, has the best interaction results and provides a cardioprotection effect, compared to the molecular interaction of the test ligands with the receptors.
abstract_zh: 硒（Se）是一种存在于植物中的微量矿物质，具有独特的硫磺气味，对心脏具有保护作用，且据报道毒性较低。印度尼西亚西爪哇省有多种具有独特气味且可生食的植物，如金果（Archidendron pauciflorum）。本研究旨在采用荧光法测定金果中的硒含量，其中金果提取物被分离，并使用高效液相色谱（HPLC）结合荧光法检测硒含量。发现两个硒浓度最高的组分（A和B），并通过液相色谱质谱联用进行表征，以通过与外部文献结果比较来预测有机硒含量。组分（A）中的硒含量被确定为硒代蛋氨酸（m/z 198）、γ-谷氨酰-甲基-硒代半胱氨酸（GluMetSeCys；m/z 313），以及半胱氨酸-硒代谷胱甘肽的硒-硫（S）共轭物（m/z 475）。此外，这些化合物被对接至参与心脏保护的受体上。这些受体包括过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体-γ（PPAR-gamma）、核因子κB（NF-kappaB）和磷酸肌醇3-激酶（PI3K/AKT）。在对接模拟中，具有最低结合能的受体与配体相互作用通过分子动力学模拟进行测量。MD模拟用于基于均方根偏差、均方根波动、回转半径和MM-PBSA参数观察键稳定性和构象。MD模拟结果显示，测试的有机硒复合物与受体的稳定性低于天然配体，而基于MM-PSBA参数的结合能也低于天然配体。这表明，金果中预测的有机硒，即γ-GluMetSeCys与PPAR-gamma、γ-GluMetSeCys与AKT/PI3K，以及半胱氨酸-硒代谷胱甘肽的Se-S共轭物与NF-kappaB，与测试配体与受体的分子相互作用相比，具有最佳的相互作用结果，并提供心脏保护效应。
